A-I1.quote: This paper provides a comprehensive overview of the Advanced Metering Infrastructure and its advantages for the Indian power distribution system.

A-I2.quote: Advanced Metering Infrastructure (AMI) plays a vital role in mitigating challenges associated with the power distribution system. It provides two-way communication for transmitting crucial data from consumers’ smart meters to the utility and vice versa.

parsed.rationale: This is a journal review article on AMI deployment, challenges and mitigation strategies in India, so smart meters are clearly the principal subject. Privacy appears only in passing: one row of the conventional-versus-smart-meter table, the mitigation advice "addressing privacy and security concerns", one sentence on research trends, and closing remarks in the cybersecurity section and conclusion. There is no dedicated privacy section, privacy is not a stated aim, and no reviewed works are compared on privacy, so the privacy component is not substantive (A-E6).
